headline: Catawba lead the table without a defeat all season
dek: Catawba's win at Anderson on Wednesday was their tenth of the season, and they have now gone twelve matches without defeat while conceding six goals. Emory & Henry, two points behind them in the table, are the only other side yet to lose.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Emory & Henry have scored fifteen and conceded four: they hold second place by keeping goals out, not by scoring them.

wire.line: Anderson's Luis Munoz has made nine goals for others this season and scored four himself.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest Emory & Henry's, the latest their home match with Newberry on Saturday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tusculum's home win over Lenoir-Rhyne on Sunday was their second of the season, against two draws and eight defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Carson-Newman's home win over Wingate on Sunday was their seventh of the season, against two draws and four defeats, with twenty-four scored and thirteen conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anderson's home win over Mars Hill on Sunday was their eighth of the season, against four draws and two defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wingate's Cole Freeman has made fifty-nine saves and conceded seventeen goals.

last_match.line: Tusculum have their first conference win; Lenoir-Rhyne followed their home win over Anderson with a defeat.

next_match.line: Newberry have not won since beating Lincoln Memorial in September; Montevallo have lost at both Anderson and Lincoln Memorial.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
